---
title: "Social lag pressure on the Gulf of California"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

This notebook turns CONEVAL's locality-level **Indice de Rezago Social Longitudinal (IRSL)** into an OHI social pressure for the Gulf of California.

Higher IRSL = more social lag = higher pressure (**1 = most pressure**).

**Why IRSL (not IRS):** the cross-sectional IRS is rebuilt each census year and is not meant for year-to-year comparisons. IRSL is designed so the same locality can be compared across 2000, 2005, 2010, and 2020.

**Pipeline:**

1. Read IRSL and reshape to one row per locality-year  
2. Assign `rgn_id` from municipality (`municipality_to_rgnid_update.csv`)  
3. Drop Ensenada and Mexicali  
4. Build locality points from census `*l.shp` centroids (+ ITER lat/lon for gaps)  
5. Keep localities inside the inland 50 km Gulf buffer  
6. Scale IRSL to 0-1 on the pooled Gulf set (90th percentile = 1)  
7. Unweighted mean by region in census years  
8. Linearly interpolate to every year 2000-2020  

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
```

## 1. Municipality to OHI region

```{r municipalities}
exclude_mun <- tibble(
  cve_ent = c("02", "02"),
  cve_mun = c("001", "002"),
  municipio_drop = c("ENSENADA", "MEXICALI")
)

mun_lookup <- read_csv(mun_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    cve_ent = str_pad(as.integer(E03), width = 2, pad = "0"),
    cve_mun = str_pad(as.integer(E04), width = 3, pad = "0"),
    rgn_id = as.character(rgn_id)
  ) %>%
  anti_join(exclude_mun, by = c("cve_ent", "cve_mun")) %>%
  select(cve_ent, cve_mun, municipio, estado, rgn_id, directly_coastal, both_pacific_gulf)

stopifnot(nrow(mun_lookup) > 0)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(mun_lookup %>% select(cve_ent, cve_mun)))

mun_lookup %>%
  count(rgn_id, name = "n_municipalities") %>%
  kable(caption = "Municipalities per OHI region after dropping Ensenada and Mexicali")
```

## 2. Read IRSL Excel (both sheets)

CONEVAL splits localities across two sheets. We force Excel columns A-CQ and data starting at row 9 with `range = cell_limits(...)`. That keeps blank leading columns, so fixed column numbers stay aligned. Using `skip` alone is unsafe because `readxl` can drop empty leading columns and then `col_clave = 3` no longer points at the locality code (that is why you saw 0 localities).

### 2a. Read sheet 1 (AGS-MICH) into wide form

```{r read-irsl-sheet1}
stopifnot(file.exists(irsl_path))
irsl_sheets <- excel_sheets(irsl_path)
irsl_sheets

# force columns 1:95 and start at first data row (excel row 9)
raw1 <- read_excel(
  irsl_path,
  sheet = irsl_sheets[[1]],
  col_names = FALSE,
  range = cell_limits(
    ul = c(irsl_data_start_row, 1),
    lr = c(NA, irsl_n_cols)
  ),
  .name_repair = "minimal"
)

# quick check: column 3 should look like 010010001
tibble(
  ncol = ncol(raw1),
  nrow = nrow(raw1),
  col1_example = as.character(raw1[[1]][1]),
  col2_example = as.character(raw1[[2]][1]),
  col3_example = as.character(raw1[[3]][1]),
  col4_example = as.character(raw1[[4]][1])
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Sheet 1 raw diagnostics (col3 should be a 9-digit clave)")

irsl_wide1 <- tibble(
  clave_raw = as.character(raw1[[col_clave]]),
  entidad = as.character(raw1[[col_entidad]]),
  municipio_irsl = as.character(raw1[[col_municipio]]),
  localidad = as.character(raw1[[col_localidad]]),
  pop_2000 = as.character(raw1[[col_pop[["pop_2000"]]]]),
  pop_2005 = as.character(raw1[[col_pop[["pop_2005"]]]]),
  pop_2010 = as.character(raw1[[col_pop[["pop_2010"]]]]),
  pop_2020 = as.character(raw1[[col_pop[["pop_2020"]]]]),
  irsl_2000 = as.character(raw1[[col_irsl[["irsl_2000"]]]]),
  irsl_2005 = as.character(raw1[[col_irsl[["irsl_2005"]]]]),
  irsl_2010 = as.character(raw1[[col_irsl[["irsl_2010"]]]]),
  irsl_2020 = as.character(raw1[[col_irsl[["irsl_2020"]]]]),
  grado_2000 = as.character(raw1[[col_grado[["grado_2000"]]]]),
  grado_2005 = as.character(raw1[[col_grado[["grado_2005"]]]]),
  grado_2010 = as.character(raw1[[col_grado[["grado_2010"]]]]),
  grado_2020 = as.character(raw1[[col_grado[["grado_2020"]]]])
) %>%
  mutate(
    # excel may store clave as numeric (losing the leading zero)
    clave_localidad = str_pad(str_replace(clave_raw, "\\.0$", ""), width = 9, pad = "0")
  ) %>%
  filter(str_detect(clave_localidad, "^[0-9]{9}$")) %>%
  select(-clave_raw)

nrow(irsl_wide1)
head(irsl_wide1 %>% select(clave_localidad, entidad, municipio_irsl, localidad, irsl_2020), 5)
```

```{r read-irsl-sheet2}
irsl_wide <- bind_rows(irsl_wide1, irsl_wide2)

irsl_wide %>%
  summarise(n_localities = n()) %>%
  kable(caption = "Localities after reading both IRSL sheets (wide)")

stopifnot(nrow(irsl_wide) > 0)
```

### 2c. Replace N.A. with missing, then pivot long

```{r irsl-clean-na}
na_tokens <- c("N.A.", "N.A", "NA", "n.a.", "n.a")

irsl_wide_clean <- irsl_wide %>%
  mutate(across(
    starts_with(c("pop_", "irsl_", "grado_")),
    ~ if_else(.x %in% na_tokens | .x == "", NA_character_, .x)
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("pop_", "irsl_")), as.numeric))
```

```{r irsl-pivot-long}
irsl_pop <- irsl_wide_clean %>%
  select(clave_localidad, entidad, municipio_irsl, localidad, starts_with("pop_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pop_"),
    names_to = "year",
    names_prefix = "pop_",
    values_to = "poblacion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

irsl_index <- irsl_wide_clean %>%
  select(clave_localidad, starts_with("irsl_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("irsl_"),
    names_to = "year",
    names_prefix = "irsl_",
    values_to = "irsl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

irsl_grado <- irsl_wide_clean %>%
  select(clave_localidad, starts_with("grado_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("grado_"),
    names_to = "year",
    names_prefix = "grado_",
    values_to = "grado"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

irsl_all <- irsl_pop %>%
  left_join(irsl_index, by = c("clave_localidad", "year")) %>%
  left_join(irsl_grado, by = c("clave_localidad", "year")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(irsl)) %>%
  mutate(
    cve_ent = str_sub(clave_localidad, 1, 2),
    cve_mun = str_sub(clave_localidad, 3, 5)
  )

irsl_all %>%
  count(year, name = "n_localities") %>%
  kable(caption = "Localities with IRSL by year (national, before Gulf filters)")
```

## 3. Join municipalities to get `rgn_id`

```{r join-regions}
irsl_mun <- irsl_all %>%
  inner_join(mun_lookup, by = c("cve_ent", "cve_mun"))

irsl_mun %>%
  count(year, name = "n_localities") %>%
  kable(caption = "Localities after municipality-to-region join")

irsl_mun %>%
  distinct(rgn_id, cve_ent, cve_mun, municipio) %>%
  count(rgn_id, name = "n_municipalities") %>%
  kable(caption = "Municipalities present in IRSL after the join")
```

## 4. Build locality points

Use the same census locality polygons as the population notebook. Centroids give coordinates for most localities. ITER fills gaps with lat/lon.

```{r locality-polygons}
loc_poly <- map_dfr(loc_shp_paths, ~ st_read(.x, quiet = TRUE)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(
    cve_ent = str_pad(as.character(CVE_ENT), width = 2, pad = "0"),
    cve_mun = str_pad(as.character(CVE_MUN), width = 3, pad = "0"),
    cve_loc = str_pad(as.character(CVE_LOC), width = 4, pad = "0"),
    clave_localidad = paste0(cve_ent, cve_mun, cve_loc)
  )

pts_from_poly <- loc_poly %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  transmute(clave_localidad, source = "polygon_centroid")
# mapview(pts_from_poly)

nrow(pts_from_poly)
```

```{r locality-iter-gaps}
iter <- read_csv(iter_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(
    ENTIDAD %in% goc_ents,
    !str_detect(NOM_LOC, "Total"),
    NOM_LOC != "Localidades de una vivienda",
    NOM_LOC != "Localidades de dos viviendas",
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(LOC))) > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    clave_localidad = paste0(
      str_pad(as.integer(ENTIDAD), 2, pad = "0"),
      str_pad(as.integer(MUN), 3, pad = "0"),
      str_pad(as.integer(LOC), 4, pad = "0")
    ),
    # iter stores coordinates as dms text; convert roughly to decimal degrees
    lon_txt = str_replace_all(LONGITUD, "[NnSsEeWw\"'?`]", ""),
    lat_txt = str_replace_all(LATITUD, "[NnSsEeWw\"'?`]", ""),
    lon_parts = str_match(lon_txt, "(\\d+)\\D+(\\d+)\\D+(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)"),
    lat_parts = str_match(lat_txt, "(\\d+)\\D+(\\d+)\\D+(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)"),
    lon_dd = -(as.numeric(lon_parts[, 2]) + as.numeric(lon_parts[, 3]) / 60 + as.numeric(lon_parts[, 4]) / 3600),
    lat_dd = as.numeric(lat_parts[, 2]) + as.numeric(lat_parts[, 3]) / 60 + as.numeric(lat_parts[, 4]) / 3600
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon_dd), !is.na(lat_dd))

missing_claves <- setdiff(iter$clave_localidad, pts_from_poly$clave_localidad)

pts_from_iter <- iter %>%
  filter(clave_localidad %in% missing_claves) %>%
  distinct(clave_localidad, lon_dd, lat_dd) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon_dd", "lat_dd"), crs = 4326) %>%
  transmute(clave_localidad, source = "iter_latlon")

pts <- bind_rows(
  st_transform(pts_from_poly, mexico_crs),
  st_transform(pts_from_iter, mexico_crs)
) %>%
  distinct(clave_localidad, .keep_all = TRUE)

tibble(
  n_polygon_centroids = nrow(pts_from_poly),
  n_iter_only = nrow(pts_from_iter),
  n_points_total = nrow(pts)
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Locality point sources")
```

## 5. Keep localities inside the inland 50 km Gulf buffer

The buffer is only a geographic filter. Region still comes from the municipality lookup.

```{r buffer-filter}
buffer <- st_read(buffer_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(mexico_crs)

pts_in_buffer <- pts %>%
  st_filter(buffer, .predicate = st_intersects)

coastal_claves <- pts_in_buffer %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(clave_localidad, source)

irsl_goc <- irsl_mun %>%
  inner_join(coastal_claves, by = "clave_localidad")

irsl_goc %>%
  count(year, name = "n_localities") %>%
  kable(caption = "Localities inside the inland 50 km Gulf buffer")

irsl_goc %>%
  distinct(cve_ent, cve_mun, municipio, rgn_id) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, cve_ent, cve_mun) %>%
  kable(caption = "Municipalities retained after municipality join + buffer filter") # no san felipe because it was not made into a municipality until 2022.
```

## 6. Scale IRSL to 0-1 (pooled Gulf locality-years)

Because IRSL is longitudinally comparable, min and the `quantile_p` ceiling are taken from **all** retained locality-years together.

```{r rescale}
ref_low <- min(irsl_goc$irsl, na.rm = TRUE)
ref_high <- as.numeric(quantile(irsl_goc$irsl, probs = quantile_p, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(is.finite(ref_low), is.finite(ref_high), ref_high > ref_low)

irsl_scaled <- irsl_goc %>%
  mutate(
    pressure = (irsl - ref_low) / (ref_high - ref_low),
    pressure = pmin(pmax(pressure, 0), 1)
  )

tibble(
  quantile = quantile_p,
  irsl_min = ref_low,
  irsl_ceiling = ref_high,
  n_locality_years = nrow(irsl_scaled),
  n_at_one = sum(irsl_scaled$pressure == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Pooled Gulf IRSL scaling")
```

```{r plot-irsl}
irsl_scaled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = irsl)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey75", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ref_high, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "IRSL on Gulf coastal localities",
    subtitle = paste0("red line = pooled Gulf ", quantile_p * 100, "th percentile (pressure = 1)"),
    x = "IRSL",
    y = "localities"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r locality-change}
change_2010_2020 <- irsl_scaled %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2010, 2020)) %>%
  select(clave_localidad, rgn_id, year, irsl, pressure) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = c(irsl, pressure)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(irsl_2010), !is.na(irsl_2020)) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_irsl = irsl_2020 - irsl_2010,
    delta_pressure = pressure_2020 - pressure_2010
  )

change_2010_2020 %>%
  summarise(
    n_localities = n(),
    mean_delta_irsl = mean(delta_irsl),
    share_improved = mean(delta_irsl < 0),
    share_worsened = mean(delta_irsl > 0)
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Locality IRSL change, 2010 to 2020 (negative = less lag)")
```

## 7. Unweighted regional means (census years)

Each locality counts equally inside its region.

```{r region-means}
scores_census <- irsl_scaled %>%
  group_by(year, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_localities = n(),
    n_municipalities = n_distinct(cve_ent, cve_mun),
    pressure = mean(pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_num = as.integer(str_remove(rgn_id, "Region_")),
    pressure = round(pressure, 4)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, rgn_num)

scores_census %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, n_localities, n_municipalities, pressure) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Unweighted social lag pressure by region (census years)")
```

## 8. Interpolate to every year 2000-2020

First build a complete region x census-year grid (missing cells are `NA`).  
`approx()` needs **at least two** non-NA census years, so regions with only one year (here Region_2 in 2020 only) are not linearly interpolated: that single year is kept, other years stay `NA`. Regions with zero years stay all `NA`.

```{r interpolate}
all_rgn_ids <- paste0("Region_", 1:9)

# complete census-year grid so every region has rows for 2000/2005/2010/2020
scores_grid <- scores_census %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, pressure, n_localities, n_municipalities) %>%
  complete(
    rgn_id = all_rgn_ids,
    year = census_years,
    fill = list(
      pressure = NA_real_,
      n_localities = 0L,
      n_municipalities = 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(rgn_num = as.integer(str_remove(rgn_id, "Region_"))) %>%
  arrange(rgn_num, year)

scores_grid %>%
  filter(is.na(pressure)) %>%
  count(rgn_id, name = "n_missing_census_years") %>%
  kable(caption = "Region-years with no social-lag pressure (cannot interpolate from these alone)")

pressure_annual <- scores_grid %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, rgn_num) %>%
  group_modify(function(df, keys) {
    ok <- !is.na(df$pressure)
    n_ok <- sum(ok)

    if (n_ok >= 2) {
      tibble(
        year = interp_years,
        pressure = approx(
          x = df$year[ok],
          y = df$pressure[ok],
          xout = interp_years,
          method = "linear",
          rule = 1
        )$y
      )
    } else if (n_ok == 1) {
      # one census year only: keep that year, leave the rest missing
      tibble(
        year = interp_years,
        pressure = if_else(interp_years == df$year[ok], df$pressure[ok], NA_real_)
      )
    } else {
      tibble(year = interp_years, pressure = NA_real_)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(rgn_num, year)

# round only for export; keep full precision for plotting so lines stay linear
pressure_csv <- pressure_annual %>%
  filter(!is.na(pressure)) %>%
  mutate(pressure = round(pressure, 2)) %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, pressure)
```

```{r write-outputs}
loc_path <- file.path(out_dir, "social_lag_localities.csv")
census_path <- file.path(out_dir, "social_lag_pressure_census_years.csv")
csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, "social_lag_pressure.csv")

loc_csv <- irsl_scaled %>%
  select(
    year, rgn_id, cve_ent, cve_mun, clave_localidad,
    entidad, municipio, localidad, poblacion,
    source, irsl, grado, pressure
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, rgn_id, clave_localidad)

write_csv(loc_csv, loc_path)
write_csv(
  scores_census %>%
    select(rgn_id, year, pressure) %>%
    mutate(pressure = round(pressure, 2)),
  census_path
)
write_csv(pressure_csv, csv_path)

pressure_annual %>%
  filter(year %in% census_years) %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, pressure) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Interpolated series at census years")
```

Locality file: `r loc_path`

Census-year regional file: `r census_path`

Annual regional file: `r csv_path`

```{r plot-region-pressure}
library(plotly)

rgn_labels <- c(
  "Region_1" = "Western Upper Gulf",
  "Region_2" = "Western Midriff Islands",
  "Region_3" = "Western Central Gulf",
  "Region_4" = "Western Southern Gulf",
  "Region_5" = "Eastern Upper Gulf",
  "Region_6" = "Eastern Midriff Islands",
  "Region_7" = "Southern Sonora Coast",
  "Region_8" = "Sinaloa Coast",
  "Region_9" = "Southeastern Gulf"
)

rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

plot_annual <- pressure_annual %>%
  mutate(
    region = recode(rgn_id, !!!rgn_labels),
    region = factor(region, levels = unname(rgn_labels))
  )

plot_census <- scores_census %>%
  mutate(
    region = recode(rgn_id, !!!rgn_labels),
    region = factor(region, levels = unname(rgn_labels))
  )

p <- ggplot(plot_annual, aes(x = year, y = pressure, color = region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = plot_census, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(unname(rgn_colors), unname(rgn_labels))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Social lag pressure by OHI region",
    subtitle = "points = census years; lines = linear interpolation",
    x = NULL,
    y = "pressure (0 = least, 1 = most)",
    color = "region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y", "colour"))
```

## Notes

- **Region:** locality -> municipality (`cve_ent` + `cve_mun`) -> `rgn_id`
- **Buffer:** geographic filter only (`inland_50km_goc.shp`)
- **Points:** census `*l.shp` centroids, plus ITER lat/lon for localities without polygons
- **Interpolation:** fills years between 2000, 2005, 2010, and 2020 only


Also note, IRSL only has census years 2000, 2005, 2010, 2020. So there are no estimated values for 2015...
